objective: Close the Brain human-UX slice: notes, Inbox, Markdown reader/editor, graph inspection/actions, and Brain questions must be usable without treating the graph as a decorative dead end.

criteria.promise: Quick notes and Inbox are real Markdown workflows: create, review, edit body, preserve front matter/provenance, discard only the triage Markdown, and keep only deliberate clips as Brain candidates.

Graph nodes are actionable: the inspector can show evidence, materialize/read derived Markdown locally, open stable local sources, and correction decisions survive reload instead of opening empty windows.

Conversing with the Brain from the launcher/Brain surfaces is understandable: recognized bilingual intents answer with current truth, preparations cite meetings/decisions/commitments, empty knowledge is explicit, and ordinary search is not hijacked.

verification_gates.expected: Markdown note, Inbox, provenance, edit, discard and human-owned corpus behavior pass.
Read here/materialization, no empty reader, evidence routes, corrections, forget/pin/reject and graph responsiveness pass.
Bilingual Brain intents, current-truth answers, preparation, no-knowledge states and launcher primer behavior pass.

recon_evidence: GraphView, CorpusReaderView, QuickNote workflows and existing focused tests were inspected. This ticket accepts the code/test UX closure while still requiring a MacBook visual pass before release packaging.

first_checkpoint.evidence: Focused QuickNote, CorpusFiles, GraphCorrections and BrainQuery test results.
